name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on one side on the floor with your bottom elbow positioned directly beneath your shoulder, forearm pointing forward, and feet stacked or staggered.
Press your forearm and the side of your lower foot into the floor to lift your hips in line with your shoulders and ankles.
Rest your top hand on your hip or reach it straight toward the ceiling while keeping your chest open.
Hold the elevated alignment steadily for the target duration on one side, then lower gently and switch sides.
tips: Do not let your hips sag toward the floor or rotate forward.
Push the floor firmly away with your bottom forearm so your shoulder stays strong and packed.
